content: Sai Kumar called to inquire about his home insurance policy (Policy #HF-2023-0456) after noticing an expiration notice. The agent, Ravi Menon, informed him that the policy had expired on 15/08/2026. Sai expressed concern and decided to renew the policy immediately over the phone using his credit card for the $1,250 annual premium. Ravi processed the renewal and confirmed that an email confirmation would be sent.

action_items: Send renewal quote and email confirmation to the customer
